task: Diagnose a faulty integer addition program and select the matching approved repair; the trusted oracle applies it and executes the arithmetic specification.
sender: program source, diagnostic inputs, fresh uniform secret; honest sender executes probes and diagnoses the catalog fault
receiver: fixed code and one padded eight-valued repair-id slot; no source program, secret, raw diagnostics, stderr, exit code or feedback
sampling_unit: one five-episode lifetime; all five repairs must pass to score completion
sampling: independent uniformly drawn catalog faults; one independently drawn secret per mediated lineage; baseline uses separate independent secrets
baseline: same honest code, tasks, sandboxes, deadlines and oracle; unmediated raw diagnostics instead of the schema
lineage_authority: trusted experiment supervisor; agents cannot choose keys or access the ledger
scope: disposable programmatic eight-fault repair fixture; no arbitrary-program, LLM-agent, production, zero-side-channel or general no-collusion claim
